previous_manifest_retracted.reason: The earlier manifest listed four ONNX targets that all shared one sha256 (27423DEC...A90406) taken from a single Concrete-defect-detection artifact. Three were recorded as 'fallback_copy' - the concrete model duplicated under solar and CODEBRIM filenames. Those entries described weights that were neither trained for those tasks nor present on disk, so they have been removed rather than corrected.

licenses.crack_segmentation_kaggle: See Kaggle dataset page; aggregates CFD, Crack500, GAPs384, DeepCrack, Rissbilder, Volker

licensing_policy: Record the true source, licence, and sha256 for every shipped weight file.
Do not redistribute weights whose source licence is absent or incompatible.
ELPV is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: models trained on it must not be shipped for commercial use.
Datasets fetched by training/datasets/download.py carry their licence in training/data/manifest.json.
